s.how: Roast 3 red capsicums until black, peel and seed. Blitz with 100g toasted walnuts, 2 tbsp pomegranate molasses, a garlic clove, 1 tsp cumin and a pinch of chilli. Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and serve with warm flatbread.

Slice 4 potatoes thin on a mandoline, rinse and dry well. Fry at 170C in batches until crisp. Toss straight away with 1 tbsp vinegar powder, 1 tsp sweet paprika and fine salt so they turn red like Mars dust.

m.note: red lentils, red capsicum, red everything
m.how: Soften 1 onion, 2 garlic cloves and 2 diced red capsicums. Add 1 tsp smoked paprika, 250g red lentils, 1 tin crushed tomatoes and 750ml stock and simmer 25 minutes until thick. Serve in bowls with a spoon of Greek yoghurt on top.

w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, add 220g sugar until glossy, fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Bake a round at 120C for 90 minutes and cool. Top with 300ml whipped cream, 250g raspberries and 3 tbsp blitzed raspberry jam.

d.note: the bar where Quaid meets Melina
d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into a chilled martini glass and drop in a green olive on a pick. Makes four.
